title: Cards stop printing "[object Object]" and quoting 1835 law in 1904
items: A measured shape like the Glessner house's dining bay used to read "[object Object]" under Attributes. Its row now shows how sure we are, its sources and why, and no garbled value.
The 1835 hay-stacking by-law and its fire limit appear only on 1835 cards. A 1904 Prairie Avenue house no longer quotes a town law passed almost seventy years before its scene.
